title: Cross-file match dedup can collapse two genuinely distinct same-day meetings
evidence: src/BrazilianSoccerMcp/Data/SoccerDatabase.cs:24 fingerprint is date|home|away|homeGoals|awayGoals with no competition component, so a league game and a cup game played the same day between the same teams with the same score are merged into one
suggestion: Include competition in the dedup fingerprint, or only dedup within the overlapping source files

title: Player position filter requires an exact FIFA position code
evidence: src/BrazilianSoccerMcp/Data/SoccerDatabase.cs:203 matches p.Position with OrdinalIgnoreCase equality, so a natural-language role like 'forward' does not map to ST/LW/CF
suggestion: Optional: map common role words to position-code groups; acceptable as-is since the tool documents the 'code' contract and the LLM can translate

title: Standings treat any competition substring across all sources as one table
evidence: src/BrazilianSoccerMcp/Data/SoccerDatabase.cs:122 GetStandings filters by competition substring and season only; BR-Football-Dataset 'Serie A' rows are normalized to 'Brasileirão Série A' (DatasetLoader.cs:17) and merged, which is correct but means standings depend on the union of sources rather than a single canonical fixture list
suggestion: None required for the spec; note that completeness of a season table depends on which source files cover that year
